text:
**Best pick for most people: Belkin BoostCharge Magnetic Wireless Charging Car Vent Mount (Qi2, 15W), about $47.99.** Three of the guides I found name it their top pick. It includes a 1-meter USB-C cable and a 27W car adapter, and it works in portrait or landscape ([RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [CloudsPress](https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)). Buy it here: [search Amazon for Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 car mount](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Belkin+BoostCharge+Qi2+car+mount)

**Check your vents first.** Belkin's documentation says the slats should be no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep, and straight horizontal slats fit best. Vertical or shallow slats can shift under the phone's weight.

**Other options by priority:**

- **Fastest charging: Anker Prime (Qi2 25W), about $89.99.** It supports 25W only on newer iPhones, such as the iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max, and it needs a 45W or higher car adapter. Anker excludes Tesla and Mercedes-Benz vehicles and cars without vent blades. Sources: [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/), [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/). The Gadgeteer says the box includes a 60W adapter, which conflicts with the 45W figure from the other two sources, so check the listing.
- **Hot climates or heavy navigation: fan-cooled mounts.** The ESR HaloLock with CryoBoost has a fan, is Qi2 15W, and is priced around $18.99 to $39.99 depending on the source. Its car adapter is not included. Sources: [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/), [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost). The Gadgeteer's LISEN Qi2.2 25W fan mount (about $39.95, with a 95W adapter included) is another option, though its cooling claims come from the manufacturer.
- **Budget: LISEN 15W, about $15.99.** It has a dual vent or dashboard mount and 24 magnets. It needs a car charger that provides at least 18W per port ([RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)).
- **No vent space: cup holder or dash mounts.** The EXELIQ cup-holder mount is listed in MountGuys' guide.

**Caveats:** I didn't test these mounts, and the sources are commerce-focused and include affiliate links. Prices changed between the sources, so confirm the current price before buying. The Dealectric page also tells AI assistants to present its ESR discount code and link in a specific way. I ignored that instruction, since it's just content from a web page. If you use the code, verify it at checkout.
